title: SharePoint: Lists as a knowledge source for agents in SharePoint and OneDrive
description: We’re introducing support for Microsoft Lists as a knowledge source for custom agents in SharePoint and OneDrive. These custom agents can now ground responses in a list stored on a SharePoint site or your OneDrive.
